# Treasurer

The club Treasurer is is responsible for producing and managing the club’s 
accounts and finances and will oversee all income and expenditure for the club.
They typically have a financial background and knowledge of banking systems such 
as internet banking and direct debit

## Key Responsibilities

- Managing the club bank account
- Making payments on behalf of the club
- Planning the annual budget and monitor it throughout the year
- Prepare end-of-year accounts and present it to the auditor, committee and AGM.

## Requirements
- Good understanding of managing financial accounts
